regions.text: 第一の體系にあつては必然性と偶然性とは現實性の地本に於て矛居對當をなすものとして一對の様相と見られ可能性と不可能性とは非現實性の地平になて矛盾對當をなすものとして一對と見られてゐる。

quote.translation: In the first system, necessity and contingency are regarded as a pair of modalities standing in contradictory opposition on the horizon of actuality, and possibility and impossibility as a pair standing in contradictory opposition on the horizon of non-actuality.

regions.text: 郷二の授系にあつては必然性と不可能性とは反對々當を構成しながら、確性の性格に於て頬似開係にあるものとして一對の様相と見られ可能性と偶然性とは小反對々當を構成しながら、間題性の性格に於て頻似開係にあるものとして一勢と見られてある。

quote.translation: In the second system, necessity and impossibility, although they constitute a contrary opposition, are regarded as a pair of modalities because they stand in a relation of similarity in their character of apodicticity, and possibility and contingency, although they constitute a subcontrary opposition, are regarded as a pair because they stand in a relation of similarity in their character of problematicity.

regions.text: 第三の蠱系にあつては、必然性と可能性とは實在性の次元に於て大小對當の近接謝係にあるるのとして一對の様相と見られ、偶然と不可能性とは嘘無性の次元に於て大小對當の近接開係にあるものとして一動と見ちれてるる。

quote.translation: In the third system, necessity and possibility are regarded as a pair of modalities standing, in the dimension of reality, in the relation of proximity that belongs to subalternation, and contingency and impossibility as a pair standing in the same relation of proximity in the dimension of nihility.

regions.text: 三欄の鑽系を左の図形で表はすことが出來る。略学および記號は左の如くである。
